summary: Capstone integrates E2.1+E2.2+E2.3 across 4 stations. Trap is now research-grounded transitivity gap (Sarama & Clements 2009; Piaget seriation) plus attribute confusion, with branched diagnostic recovery. Unit refrain 'Measure it! / Match it! / Mark the day!' anchors voice through minds_on, action step 1, and exit_routine. NO-PREP station path makes the lesson runnable without prep. Worksheet maps cleanly to lesson stations but is a fairly direct rote mirror rather than a deliberate transfer task — consistency stays at 3.
